data.body: Design decisions 2026-11-09 (operator, via coordinator), recorded in ADR 0123 (now Accepted): (1) engine switch = [verify] plan_review_engine, values "pipeline" | "agentic", default "pipeline"; precedence per-call argument > config key > default; no environment variable. (4) agentic runtime = rebar's runner in agentic mode with the read_file/list_directory/search_files tools plus ticket reads, comment_ticket withheld; read-only enforced by the absent write/exec tools, fs_tools._safe_path, and the gate snapshot; the Claude Agent SDK was rejected because it breaks Bedrock-first fallback and project.portability. (6) limits = tool_step_limit 60 (then it must answer), iteration_limit 80, model-maximum output, existing per-request timeout; no new setting.
